_comment: Hand-labelled set for the city-scope classifier. 'city': true means a city government could plausibly report this indicator for its own territory. Labels are a judgment call and belong under review -- argue with them by editing this file, then re-run `python3 probe/scope.py --eval`. Names are taken verbatim from the enumerated SDG corpus.
